title: NIRF Data Capturing System - form schema for IIT Mandi (Overall, Engineering, Innovation, SDG)

derivedFrom.caveat: Structure is reverse-engineered from IIT Mandi's SUBMITTED 2026 data, not from the blank NIRF template. Dropdown option lists that only show the selected value are flagged optionsComplete=false / provisional. Diff against the official 2027 DCS when it opens (an unofficial consultancy page expects Nov-Dec 2026; unconfirmed).

yearModel.summary: All year columns are relative to the latest completed academic year (LAY) of the cycle, so the same schema works for every cycle.
yearModel.series: {kind, count} -> newest first: offsets 0, -1, ... -(count-1) from the latest year of that kind.

2026.source: IIT Mandi NIRF 2026 PDFs (matches the formulas)

2027.source: Derived by the formulas; the official 2027 DCS has not been published yet

placementBatchRule.UG4: entry AY = graduation AY - 3; lateral-entry AY = graduation AY - 2
placementBatchRule.verifiedAgainst: IIT Mandi NIRF 2026 Overall PDF (e.g. UG: intake 2019-20, lateral 2020-21, graduating 2022-23)

yearModel.overridable: DataRequest/cycle config may override latestAcademicYearStart if NIRF changes the reference window.

types.decimal: Number with up to 3 decimals >= min.
types.currencyInr: Rupees, decimal(16,2), >= 0. UI shows Indian grouping (12,34,567).
types.boolean: Yes/No (tri-state in UI: unanswered / yes / no; required means answered).
types.yearLabel: Pick from a resolved year series (e.g. 2024-25) - series is on the field.
types.enum: Single choice from schema.enums[enum]; allowOther adds a free-text 'Other'.
types.orgUnit: Reference to an OrgUnit id, restricted by eligibleUnitKinds.
types.recordRef: Reference to a row of another records block in the same section: {block, key, label}.
types.derived: Fields with 'derive' are computed server- and client-side and are read-only.

grid.rowAxis.type.programme: one row per active Programme of the submitting unit; roll-up groups by programme.nirfLevel
grid.rowAxis.type.programmeBatch: programme x graduating batch (batchSeries, entryBeforeGraduation, lateralBeforeGraduation)
grid.rowAxis.type.levelBatch: nirfLevel x graduating batch; institute-level (central) use

grid.columnAxis.type.years: one homogeneous cell type repeated per year (series, cell)

dsl.row overrides: rows[].type / usedBy (subset of section.usedBy) / labelByCategory / ownerUnitIds / derive
dsl.validations.severity: error blocks Submit; warning requires an explanatory note before Submit.

flags.carryForward: prefill from previous cycle's APPROVED data (overlapping years shift by one)
flags.allowEmpty: records block may be empty but the officer must tick 'Nothing to report'
flags.pii: personal data: no logging, mask in lists

ownership.submitBy.unit: each eligible SCHOOL/CENTRE submits its own rows; institute value = roll-up sum
ownership.submitBy.central: one primary owner unit submits the institute-wide values

gender.note: DCS shows Male/Female only; keep unless the 2027 DCS adds a value.

notCollectedViaDcs.reason: Not present in IIT Mandi's 2025 or 2026 DCS submissions; NIRF retrieves these from third-party databases. Also carries a retracted-paper penalty (reported for 2026 by unofficial sources).
Survey-based; not entered by the institute in the DCS.
Listed (15 marks) in the 2024 parameter table on iitmandi.ac.in but absent from the 2025 and 2026 submitted PDFs. Re-check when the 2027 DCS opens.

optionsEvidence.method: Submitted NIRF PDFs only show the option(s) an institute selected, so the dropdown lists are reconstructed from the union of values seen across institutes. Accept an option once seen in >= 2 institutes; anything seen in 1 stays flagged until confirmed against the live DCS.
notYetSampled: IIT Madras / IISc / VIT Innovation 2026 (for investment-type, achievement-level, course-type and course-level dropdowns)

crossChecks.description: placement-outcomes.intake is read-only and looked up from sanctioned-intake by programme and entry academic year.
Sum of sponsored-project-register receipts per financial year (all units) should be within 1% of sponsored-research.amountReceived; show a reconciliation panel to DORA.
sdg-green-coverage.landAreaAcres and sdg-health-wellbeing.totalCampusAreaAcres should agree for the same year. IIT Mandi's 2026 SDG PDF shows 56 vs 503 acres - the portal must flag this.
If sdg-water rainwaterHarvesting = true (or sustainable-living rainwaterHarvesting is set) then rwhConnectedAreaSqft should be > 0. The 2026 SDG PDF reports 0.
UG4 total students should not exceed about 4x the largest sanctioned intake in the last 4 years (+ lateral entry); PG2 about 2x.
faculty-details cannot be APPROVED until every school/centre that owns at least one faculty row has a CONFIRMED RecordVerification.
Flag faculty whose leavingDate is before the start of the earliest reference year, or joiningDate after the end of the latest reference year.
An institute roll-up for a 'unit'-scope section is complete only when every active SCHOOL/CENTRE unit has an APPROVED or Not-Applicable submission.
